resources.string: A compass from the phone\'s own sensors, offline, no location needed.
This phone has no magnetometer, so it can\'t show a compass.
Low accuracy: move the phone in a figure 8 a few times, away from metal and magnets.

Points to magnetic north, worked out on this phone with no internet. True north differs by a few degrees depending on where you are; it would need your location, which BOAR doesn\'t ask for. Hold the phone flat.
